Yes, you'll still get that box, and the money won't be refunded. Plant Club is charged on the 25th for the following month, so the box was already billed when you cancelled on the 26th. An already-billed box is not refunded on cancellation and is still sent. It ships in the first full week of the month.

Your cancellation applies from the box after that, so you won't be charged again, and there's no cancellation fee. If you think you were billed in error, I can escalate this to a Support Lead.
